verdict.rationale: Undermind is a SaaS research service, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask, but the evidence documents no Undermind-branded CLI. The docs only show its MCP server connecting to third-party CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Copilot CLI) and an API. Those CLIs are other products' clients, and the MCP server and API are adjacent capabilities, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
